rows.remarksWeb: 1. The Trustees of Smt Sunitidevi Singhania Hospital Trust (Promoter Group Entity) are as under:  a. Shri Gautam Hari Singhania, Chairman and Managing Trustee  b. Smt. Ashadevi Singhania, Trustee  c. Shri Rakesh Kumar Tiwary, Trustee  d. Shri Jitender Agarwal, Trustee  2.
